validation_notes: The right edge of the chart (mid-June through late July) shows a sharp V-shaped recovery from ~1560 up to ~1950, followed by a fairly flat, tight consolidation around 1830-1950 with low volume. This is more of a rectangular/range-bound consolidation than a converging triangle - the highs and lows over the last ~25 candles are roughly parallel (flat top near 1950, flat bottom near 1830) rather than converging toward an apex. There isn't a clear pattern of higher lows meeting lower highs; instead price is oscillating in a narrow horizontal band. I don't see the two trendlines pinching together as required for a symmetric triangle - it looks more like a flag/consolidation after the sharp rally off the lows.
